description: Retrieve timestamped YouTube captions with a bundled transcript API, then create evidence-grounded analysis.

defaultPrompt: Summarize this YouTube video with timestamped key points.
Answer my question using this video's transcript.
Compare these YouTube videos using timestamped evidence.
interface.longDescription: TubeCue retrieves manual or auto-generated YouTube captions with a bundled transcript API, verifies video provenance, and creates source-grounded summaries, answers, study notes, chapter breakdowns, comparisons, and fact-checks. It uses an interactive Tactiq fallback when direct retrieval is blocked.

name: tubecue
